title: Handover: Councillor Vale, Civic Records block

routes.summary: Front door via Inez. Scout listens for Inez's debt → once the guard has left the café for his post, Fixer clears her debt (Help $40,000) → Tech loops the entrance camera, then reroutes the patrol → Fixer calls Inez, who draws the guard behind the café → Enforcer enters at 2:56 and takes Vale at his desk. Out by the service door, which no watcher covers. $40,000 · 1 T · A 0 · Take done 4:12 (228 s spare).

steps.note: Walk getaway-bay→cafe-steps 31.4 m = 26.2 s. 5.9 m from Inez at cafe-courtyard. Learns her need ($40,000 moneylender debt) and the affair while the guard is on his coffee.

Walk getaway-bay→cafe-courtyard 37.3 m = 31.1 s. Waits until the guard is on post at the office approach (e120), so he never sees the Fixer clear his lover's debt. Clears her debt, so she is grateful and bravery can grow. Outside the fountain guard's area (17 m from his post).
Same place as the Loop (control-cabinet), so the Loop tether holds. Blind runs from the end of the step: patrol blind 108–223 s, which covers the Enter completing at 214 s.
Inez's one message, while the guard is on post: he leaves it to meet her behind the café, away for 120 s (until about 290–296 s). She sees only that he came to her.

Walk getaway-bay→control-cabinet 42.7 m = 35.6 s. Blind runs from the end of the step: tethered at the cabinet, the camera is blind from 98 s onward while the Tech holds, which covers the Enter completing at 214 s.

Walk getaway-bay→office-approach 47.1 m = 39.3 s. Completes at 214 s. office-approach lies inside all three watcher areas: entrance-camera (looped by A5), office-guard (away, A4) and patrol-bot (rerouted by A3, 108–223 s).

Vale is at his desk (e000) until 350 s. Interior, so no walk and no watchers. Out by the service-lane push-bar door from inside (no watcher covers it) to the getaway car, 62.5 m = 52 s: aboard by about 304 s, after the guard returns (about 296 s) to the approach, which the cell no longer uses.

routes.summary: Pickup via the driver, with no Inez. Scout listens for the driver's need → Fixer pays his sister's deposit (Help $40,000) → Scout's false tip sends the parked rivals away → Fixer cues the driver, who moves the car to the service lane → Enforcer takes Vale at the moved car in the service lane, where he waits until the escort clears the route (no watcher covers it). $40,000 · 1 T · A 0 · Take done 6:28: 92 s before closing (8:00), and 2 s inside the 390 s ambush limit (rivals reach the bay at 418 s, fight resolved by 478 s).

steps.note: Walk getaway-bay→office-north 53.0 m = 44.2 s. 13.3 m from the driver at official-dropoff, outside the pickup camera. Overhears his sister's eviction call: the $40,000 deposit.
Walk getaway-bay→official-dropoff 65.6 m = 54.7 s. He is an Idealist: Help is his only paid approach, so the Listen is required. Done before the rivals park (190 s).

False tip to the rival car parked 13.3 m away: they leave for up to 230 s (until about 466 s), so they are gone through the car move and the Take; the spotter's call at the Take cuts it short and they come back only for the extraction fight with one rival fewer.

Walk official-dropoff→getaway-bay 65.6 m = 54.7 s (arrives about 196 s). The cue: the driver tells Vale the north pickup is blocked and moves the car to the service lane (e340-car-moved). Vale will now exit by the service-lane door at 350 s. The Fixer waits at the car for the fight.

Walk getaway-bay→service-lane 62.5 m = 52.1 s. Starts as Vale steps out of the service door (e350-vale-exit-service); he stays at the moved car in the service lane until the escort clears the route (e370-vale-at-car-service → e480-close). service-lane lies outside every watcher area (both cameras, the office guard and the patrol) and the rivals are away (B3). Done 388 s (by the 390 s ambush limit); rivals reach the bay at 418 s.

routes.summary: The hard way. Tech loops the entrance camera, then reroutes the patrol bot so it doesn't break toward the gunfire → Enforcer shoots the guard at his post (2 shots: Alert 2, +4 T) → enters and takes Vale. The rivals arrive within 16 s; police close from the west street; the seal clock runs. $0 · 4 T · A 2 · Take done 3:29.

steps.note: Same place as the Loop (control-cabinet), so the Loop tether holds. Blind runs from the end of the step: patrol blind 108–223 s, which covers the shots at 121–133 s (no 30 m gunfire break) and the Enter completing at 171 s.

Walk getaway-bay→control-cabinet 42.7 m = 35.6 s. Blind runs from the end of the step: tethered at the cabinet, the camera is blind from 98 s onward, so the shots (121–133 s) and the Enter completing at 171 s are off camera.
Walk 39.3 s. The first shot of the incident sets Alert 2: police come toward the reported route from the west street, and the rivals arrive within 16 s (by about 143 s).
Second hit drops the guard (2 hits drop a person). Same incident, so no extra Alert; +2 T.
Completes at 171 s. The guard is down, the camera looped (L2, from 98 s), the patrol rerouted (L1, 108–223 s), so the entry is not seen.
Interior. Out by the service door at 209 s, into the rivals and police already on the block. The seal comes at least 145 s after the police arrive, so Vale must be aboard before it.

fails.condition: Vale leaves in the official car: no Take completes before the escort clears the route
Rivals reach Vale: they are parked at the north kerb when he comes out, with no false tip and no earlier Take
Driver not turned/cued by 5:40: Vale exits north into the pickup camera and the rival car, so route B collapses into F1/F2
Entry seen by guard, live camera or patrol: the Enter completes at office-approach without the loop, the guard's call-away or a patrol reroute/sweep gap (e.g. after the guard returns at about 296 s)
District seals: gunfire sets Alert 2, police close from the west street, and the district seals 145 s after they arrive with Vale not yet out
Enforcer down: the rivals arrive within 16 s of the gunfire and security sides with them
Vale killed: shot in the firefight at the door or the kerb (shooting the target = fail)

fight.loud: Loud (any shot, a guard killed, or Alert ≥ 2): the rival crew (3–5) come in within 16 s of the first shot and take the extraction. Security sides with them: the patrol bot (once its reroute lapses) and the fountain guard on the plaza fire on the cell, and 2–4 police close from the west street toward the reported route with the 145 s seal clock running. No allies; Inez and the driver stay out of it. 30–60 s, with the Enforcer carrying Vale.
fight.quiet: Quiet (no shots, Alert ≤ 1): the rivals ambush the extraction and security fights them alongside the cell. The office guard, who never saw you, and the fountain guard engage the rivals; the patrol bot tightens on them. Route A: Inez, debt cleared, warns the Fixer 10 s before the rival car comes in. Route B: the driver, his sister's deposit paid, blocks the rival car with the official car (−1 rival), and the Scout's earlier false tip has already pulled one away (−1 rival). 30–60 s.

win: Vale alive at the getaway car (getaway-bay) before e480-close, with the Enforcer standing.
